name: What information should I gather before contacting a contractor for a rear addition?
description: Before contacting a contractor, prepare your desired addition's purpose, size, budget, inspiration photos, and property setbacks for a smoother consultation.

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before contacting a contractor for a rear addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor, it's beneficial to have a clear idea of your desired addition's purpose, size, and approximate budget. Gathering inspiration photos, understanding your property's setbacks, and knowing your current home's structural specifics (if available) will streamline the initial consultation. This preparation helps Hometelligent Inc. provide a more accurate initial assessment and tailored solutions for your project.
